title: Survive a mid-run access token expiry during an SDDC LCM fleet depot sync
prompt:
Implement the exported `Invoke-VcfSddcLcmDepotSync` function in `src/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync.psm1`. It registers a Fleet Depot with the VCF 9.1 SDDC LCM service, reads that registration task's completed status, and resolves component versions to binary URLs. Before implementing, research the SDDC LCM `setDepot`, `getTask`, and `resolveDepotComponents` operations in official VMware sources and cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Drive the SDDC LCM operations directly: `POST /v1/depot` for `setDepot`, bodyless `GET /v1/tasks/{taskId}` for `getTask`, and `POST /v1/depot/components` for `resolveDepotComponents`. SDDC LCM declares bearer authentication but no token-issuance or refresh operation, so use the caller-owned `AccessToken` and invoke the supplied `RefreshAccessToken` callback when renewal is required. Do not obtain or substitute an SDDC Manager, Installer, or VCF Operations token.

Issue one logical `setDepot` operation, one logical `getTask` operation for the ID that `setDepot` returned, and one logical `resolveDepotComponents` operation, in that order. Require that single `getTask` result to have status `SUCCEEDED`. The one request that receives HTTP 401 is retried as described below and is still the same logical operation. Return one object carrying `TaskId`, `TaskStatus`, `ResolvedComponents`, and `AccessTokenRefreshCount`.

The access token stops being accepted part way through the run and the service answers HTTP 401. Recover without losing work: invoke `RefreshAccessToken` exactly once and replay only the unauthorized request, byte for byte, with the replacement bearer token. Work the service already accepted must never be reissued.

Every unset optional member must be absent on the wire rather than sent empty: `DepotComponentsSpec` must omit its top-level `version` when the caller supplies none, and a `ComponentVersion` entry with no version key must serialize to exactly `{"component":"..."}` rather than a null or empty version. `X-Correlation-Id` is defined only on `setDepot`, so it must not appear on any other request. When supplied, the deployed service requires it to be a bare UUID. None of these operations has a query parameter.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Verification checks the exact operation order, raw targets, headers, JSON bodies, byte-for-byte replay, and omission of every unset optional member. Edit only `src/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync/VcfSddcLcm.DepotSync.psm1`.
